review_locator: PMCID:PMC7672641, L1CAM as an E-selectin Ligand in Colon Cancer; PMCID:PMC3195965, CD44 and HCELL review
primary_title: L1CAM as an E-selectin Ligand in Colon Cancer
decision_basis: The reviews identify L1CAM among tumor-cell adhesion ligands and the cited primary study identifies L1CAM as the prominent E-selectin-binding glycoprotein in FUT6-glycoengineered colon-cancer cells, with immunoprecipitation and flow validation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve FUT6/sialyl-Lewis-X glycoengineering, human metastatic-colon-cancer model, and E-selectin ligand-identification context; no L1CAM intracellular relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2559865, Targeting selectins and selectin ligands in inflammation and cancer; PMCID:PMC6711759, Selectins in cancer immunity
primary_title: Death receptor-3, a new E-Selectin counter-receptor that confers migration and survival advantages to colon carcinoma cells by triggering p38 and ERK MAPK activation; Survival advantages conferred to colon cancer cells by E-selectin-induced activation of the PI3K-NFkB survival axis downstream of Death receptor-3
decision_basis: The reviews identify DR3/TNFRSF25 as a tumor-cell E-selectin counter-receptor and the cited primary studies demonstrate E-selectin affinity capture/DR3 dependence together with p38, ERK, PI3K-Akt/NF-kB, migration, adhesion, and survival responses in colon-carcinoma cells.
limitations_preserved: Preserve E-selectin presentation and colon-cancer DR3 isoform context, including death-domain-deficient splice variants; do not generalize to canonical TNFRSF25/TL1A signaling or SCI.

primary_title: Activation and desensitization of the recombinant P2X1 receptor at nanomolar ATP concentrations
decision_basis: ATP activates recombinant rat P2X1/P2RX1 in Xenopus oocytes as a ligand-gated cation channel
limitations_preserved: Preserve rapid desensitization and recombinant-oocyte context; ATP-gated channel activation is the supported output and no SCI inference is made.

primary_title: Molecular characterization and pharmacological properties of the human P2X3 purinoceptor
decision_basis: ATP activates cloned human P2X3/P2RX3 in Xenopus oocytes as a fast-desensitizing ligand-gated channel
limitations_preserved: Preserve fast desensitization and human-receptor/oocyte context; no native sensory-neuron or SCI inference.

primary_title: Pharmacological and biophysical properties of the human P2X5 receptor
decision_basis: ATP activates full-length human P2X5/P2RX5 expressed in HEK293 cells, producing inward cation currents and calcium permeability
limitations_preserved: Use full-length human P2X5 and HEK293 context; preserve atypical permeability and do not generalize to truncated isoforms or SCI.
